$comment: Shared TypeScript base for all Evolith workspaces (W-Build). Every package extends this and overrides only structural settings it genuinely needs (module/moduleResolution, rootDir/outDir, decorators, types). Behavioural settings live here so they cannot drift. Target stays ES2021 deliberately: ES2022+ flips useDefineForClassFields to true, which breaks NestJS constructor-DI and decorator metadata.
